description: Lock in final gnomAD numbers for UNC119 p.Gly22Val and build the consolidated evidence figure for the report
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Re-query gnomAD v4 to lock in the exact numbers quoted in the final report.
q = """
query {
  v1: variant(variantId: "17-28552493-C-A", dataset: gnomad_r4) {
    variant_id rsids
    genome { ac an af homozygote_count populations { id ac an homozygote_count } }
    exome  { ac an af homozygote_count populations { id ac an homozygote_count } }
  }
  gene(gene_symbol: "UNC119", reference_genome: GRCh38) {
    gene_id
    gnomad_constraint { pLI oe_lof oe_lof_upper exp_lof obs_lof mis_z syn_z oe_mis }
  }
}
"""
d = requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api", json={"query": q}, timeout=180).json()["data"]
v = d["v1"]; con = d["gene"]["gnomad_constraint"]
print("variant", v["variant_id"], v["rsids"])
for src in ["genome","exome"]:
    s = v[src]
    if s:
        print(src, "AC", s["ac"], "AN", s["an"], "AF", round(s["af"],5), "hom", s["homozygote_count"])
        for p in s["populations"]:
            if p["id"] in ("afr","nfe","eas","sas","amr","fin","mid","asj","remaining") and p["an"]>0:
                print("   ", p["id"], "AC", p["ac"], "AN", p["an"], "AF", round(p["ac"]/p["an"],5), "hom", p.get("homozygote_count"))
print("constraint", con)

# Global AF across genome+exome
ac = sum(v[s]["ac"] for s in ["genome","exome"] if v[s])
an = sum(v[s]["an"] for s in ["genome","exome"] if v[s])
hom = sum(v[s]["homozygote_count"] for s in ["genome","exome"] if v[s])
af_global = ac/an
afr = {}
for s in ["genome","exome"]:
    if v[s]:
        for p in v[s]["populations"]:
            if p["id"]=="afr":
                afr["ac"] = afr.get("ac",0)+p["ac"]; afr["an"] = afr.get("an",0)+p["an"]
                afr["hom"] = afr.get("hom",0)+(p.get("homozygote_count") or 0)
af_afr = afr["ac"]/afr["an"]
print("\nGLOBAL AC/AN", ac, an, "AF", round(af_global,5), "hom", hom)
print("AFR AC/AN", afr["ac"], afr["an"], "AF", round(af_afr,5), "hom", afr["hom"])

# Maximum credible allele frequency (Whiffin 2017) for a dominant allele
def max_cred(prev, allelic, pen): return prev*allelic/pen/2.0
scen = [("1/100,000 prev, 100% allelic, 100% pen", 1e-5,1.0,1.0),
        ("1/10,000 prev, 100% allelic, 50% pen",   1e-4,1.0,0.50),
        ("1/10,000 prev, 100% allelic, 10% pen",   1e-4,1.0,0.10),
        ("1/1,000 prev, 100% allelic, 5% pen",     1e-3,1.0,0.05)]
rows=[]
for lab,p,a,pen in scen:
    m = max_cred(p,a,pen)
    rows.append((lab, m, af_afr/m, af_global/m))
mc = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["scenario","maxAF","fold_AFR","fold_global"])
print(mc.to_string(index=False))

# Hardy-Weinberg expected homozygotes in AFR
exp_hom = af_afr**2 * (afr["an"]/2)
print("\nAFR expected hom under HWE:", round(exp_hom,1), " observed:", afr["hom"])

# Power of the original 60-control panel to see >=1 carrier at the AFR frequency
for n,lab in [(60,"original 60 controls")]:
    p0 = stats.binom.pmf(0, 2*n, af_afr)
    print(f"P(0 carriers in {lab}, 2N={2*n}) = {p0:.3f}")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(16.5, 5.0))

# Panel A: observed AF vs maximum credible AF
ax = axes[0]
ypos = np.arange(len(mc))[::-1]
ax.barh(ypos, mc["maxAF"], color="#9ecae1", height=0.55, label="maximum credible AF")
ax.axvline(af_afr, color="#cb181d", lw=2.2, label=f"observed AF, African ancestry = {af_afr:.4f}")
ax.axvline(af_global, color="#f16913", lw=2.0, ls="--", label=f"observed AF, all gnomAD v4 = {af_global:.4f}")
for y,(m,f) in zip(ypos, zip(mc["maxAF"], mc["fold_AFR"])):
    ax.text(m*1.25, y, f"{f:,.0f}x exceeded", va="center", fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_yticks(ypos); ax.set_yticklabels(mc["scenario"], fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_xlabel("allele frequency (log scale)")
ax.set_title("A  UNC119 c.65G>T p.Gly22Val exceeds every\nplausible dominant allele frequency ceiling", fontsize=10.5, loc="left")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right")

# Panel B: carrier counts by ancestry
ax = axes[1]
pops={}
for s in ["genome","exome"]:
    if v[s]:
        for p in v[s]["populations"]:
            if p["an"]>0 and p["id"] in ("afr","amr","asj","eas","fin","mid","nfe","sas","remaining"):
                e=pops.setdefault(p["id"],{"ac":0,"an":0}); e["ac"]+=p["ac"]; e["an"]+=p["an"]
pb = pd.DataFrame([{"pop":k,"af":v2["ac"]/v2["an"],"ac":v2["ac"],"an":v2["an"]} for k,v2 in pops.items()]).sort_values("af")
cols = ["#cb181d" if p=="afr" else "#6baed6" for p in pb["pop"]]
ax.barh(np.arange(len(pb)), pb["af"], color=cols, height=0.6)
labels={"afr":"African/African American","amr":"Admixed American","asj":"Ashkenazi Jewish","eas":"East Asian",
        "fin":"Finnish","mid":"Middle Eastern","nfe":"Non-Finnish European","sas":"South Asian","remaining":"Remaining"}
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(pb))); ax.set_yticklabels([labels[p] for p in pb["pop"]], fontsize=8.5)
for i,(a,n_) in enumerate(zip(pb["ac"],pb["an"])):
    ax.text(pb["af"].iloc[i]+0.0007, i, f"{a:,}/{n_:,}", va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("allele frequency in gnomAD v4")
ax.set_title("B  The allele is an African-ancestry polymorphism,\nnot a rare disease variant", fontsize=10.5, loc="left")

# Panel C: the four independent lines of evidence
ax = axes[2]; ax.axis("off")
lines = [
 ("Population genetics", f"AF {af_afr:.4f} in African ancestry, {afr['hom']} homozygotes\nClinVar: Benign/Likely benign", "#cb181d"),
 ("Nomenclature", "Published \"V22G\" is wrong: codon 22 GGC>GTC\nis Gly>Val, so p.Gly22Val", "#cb181d"),
 ("Protein structure", "pLDDT 31.5 at Gly22; 96% of residues 1-50 below 50\nabsent from density in all 9 UNC119A structures (59-237)", "#cb181d"),
 ("Mouse genetics", "0/280 significant IMPC tests in 15 procedures\nlymphocyte count p = 0.76 (hom), viable and fertile", "#cb181d"),
 ("Supporting biology", "UNC119-ARL3-LCK axis is real T cell biology\n(PMID 30220567); pathway stays a candidate", "#2171b5"),
]
ax.text(0.0, 0.97, "C  Four independent tests of the UNC119 gene-disease claim", fontsize=10.5, va="top", weight="bold")
y=0.84
for t,b,c in lines:
    ax.text(0.0, y, t, fontsize=9.5, weight="bold", color=c, va="top")
    ax.text(0.0, y-0.055, b, fontsize=8.3, va="top", color="#333333")
    y -= 0.185
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
